scope: Original 19 final exported EAGLE heads only; no intermediate-checkpoint search, DSpark extension, deployment or routing changes.

selection.opb_forgetting: Report without excluding specialist selection. A material regression prevents broad-replacement recommendation.

confirmation.prompt_passes: Complete original held-out workload passes at every concurrency; natural EOS and original completion caps, Apertus sampling T=0.7/top_p=0.8/top_k=20/seed=1.
confirmation.correctness: First 32 prompts of every original confirmation workload, greedy, max_tokens=256, seed=1. Original calibrated divergence gate/default tolerances using base/base and adapted/adapted cross-deployment controls from GPU-swapped rounds. No proof of losslessness.

recommendation.claim: Recommend only measured workload/k/concurrency cells with >=10% throughput and >=10% median decode-latency improvement in BOTH swapped repeats. Report any material TTFT/tail/OPB regression as a conditional tradeoff; never infer serving gain from simulated acceptance. No blanket all-workload claim.

cost: Report absolute latency, tok/s, GPU-seconds per million output tokens and conservative break-even output tokens using full trace allocation plus all training allocations for the selected domain, with selected training-loop lower bound and whole-recovery allocated compute separately. No monetary tariff assumed.
terminal_behavior: No qualifying development heads => negative_complete. Finite scientifically negative independent arms continue. Missing/corrupt artifacts, nonfinite updates, launch errors or correctness failures => needs_repair. Completed serving with no substantial repeatable cell => negative_complete; otherwise complete with narrowly scoped verdict/tradeoffs.
